comments.text: Not in this video, but very close to the Black Forest is Freiburg im Breisgau. It's old city has nearly as much charm as Heidelberg, and the surrounding high Black Forest (Hochschwarzwald), can be reached via a stunning train ride through the Höllental. If you go, both are absolutely worth a visit.
